method.control: Untouched, full-file 3400 Hz, a 0.38 gain reduction, and a time-shifted local ordinary cut from the following six seconds of the same capture. All local interventions use identical 25 ms fades.
method.gate: Find at least 80% useful locations on each lowpass cutoff and at least one useful location in each capture, while flagging at most one untouched or ordinary/gain control. Whole-file-filter controls should carry no local report; explicitly count unassessed. Compare prior two-edge transition outcomes. A useful span covers at least half the intervention and reaches 0.30 IoU.
method.point: Freeze before held scoring. Based on initial development, use median flanks, 65th percentile interior, a -80 dBFS minimum upper-band level, 12 dB maximum flank disagreement, 7 dB limit on middle-band change and a strict 16 dB minimum drop in both upper bands.
method.positive: 10-pole zero-phase whole-mix lowpass at 3400 or 3800 Hz during an 0.8-1.0 second interval chosen by the original PCM digest with 25 ms cosine edges. Both flanks and all controls derive from the same frozen recording.
method.sources: Four AMI recordings from source meetings excluded from both initial bandwidth banks. Per session choose eight six-second excerpts, one per eighth of meeting duration, by content-independent SHA-256 ordering among nonoverlapping twelve-second grid starts away from meeting edges. Read channel 01 signed 16-bit mono 16 kHz without scaling.
